import sys, json, pathlib, numpy as np

from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image
r = Robot()
CAMS = list(r.spec()['cameras'])
ROOT = pathlib.Path('/app/runs')
def observe(name):
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS, include_depth=True)
    obs.save(ROOT/name)
    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(ROOT/name/f'{cam}.png')
    return obs
def state(obs):
    p=obs.meta['proprio']
    return dict(zip(p['layout'],p['now']))
def submit(name, actions):
    out=r.submit('ee_delta',np.asarray(actions,dtype=np.float64),dt=r.spec()['control_dt'],cameras=CAMS,video='both',include_depth=True,note=name)
    out.save(ROOT/name)
    for cam, im in out.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(ROOT/name/f'{cam}.png')
    print(json.dumps(out.meta,indent=2))
    return out
if __name__=='__main__':

import sys, json, pathlib, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image
r = Robot()
CAMS = list(r.spec()['cameras'])
ROOT = pathlib.Path('/app/runs')
def observe(name):
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS, include_depth=True)
    obs.save(ROOT/name)
    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(ROOT/name/f'{cam}.png')
    return obs
def state(obs):
    p=obs.meta['proprio']
    return dict(zip(p['layout'],p['now']))
def submit(name, actions):
    out=r.submit('ee_delta',np.asarray(actions,dtype=np.float64),dt=r.spec()['control_dt'],cameras=CAMS,video='both',include_depth=True,note=name)
    out.save(ROOT/name)
    for cam, im in out.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(ROOT/name/f'{cam}.png')
    print(json.dumps({k:out.meta.get(k) for k in ['control_steps','time_left_s','done','reason','executed_rows']},indent=2))
    return out
if __name__=='__main__':
    print(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    obs=observe('000_initial')
    print(json.dumps(obs.meta,indent=2))

def move_to(name, tcp_goal, grip=-1, speed=.25, settle=20):
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS,include_depth=True)
